overview: Markets: Sensex and Nifty fell a third session as oil rebounded and the rupee held near a record low of 96/dollar.
Big story: The US completed its troop withdrawal from Iraq, ending a 12-year mission against the Islamic State group.

items.headline: US completes troop withdrawal from Iraq after 12-year mission
items.summary: The US military said its withdrawal from Iraq is complete, ending a 12-year campaign that defeated the Islamic State as an organised force. The last troops left an airbase in Kurdish-run northern Iraq; Baghdad called it a sovereignty milestone while Iran-backed groups celebrated.

items.headline: South Africa summons US ambassador for third time in months
items.summary: South Africa's foreign ministry called in US envoy Leo Brent Bozell III over what it called "undiplomatic conduct," the third such rebuke since he took the post in February. Ties remain strained by Trump's repeated claims of persecution against white South Africans.

items.headline: Sensex, Nifty fall for third session as oil rebounds
items.summary: The Sensex slipped to 72,480.29 and the Nifty fell to 22,620.45 as crude rebounded on fading hopes of a US-Iran resolution. Realty and bank stocks gained while pharma and metals dragged, underlining how oil swings are now driving Indian equities.

items.headline: Rupee holds near record low of 96 per dollar
items.summary: The rupee traded near 95.97-96 per dollar as foreign portfolio outflows and high oil prices weighed, with the RBI intervening through dollar sales to cushion the fall. Persistent central-bank support underscores the currency's exposure to crude prices and bond-yield stress.

items.headline: Apple Pay finally launches in India via Axis Bank
items.summary: Apple began rolling out Apple Pay in India with Axis Bank as its first banking partner, entering a payments market dominated by the state-backed UPI. The service works on Visa and Mastercard but not RuPay, and HDFC, ICICI and SBI Card are not yet on board.

items.headline: Iran-US talks via Qatari mediator make little progress
items.summary: Qatari mediator Ali al-Thawadi met Iran's foreign minister Abbas Araghchi and then US envoy Jared Kushner, but efforts to broker a breakthrough on ending the Middle East war have stalled. The impasse keeps regional oil-supply risk elevated for global markets.

items.headline: Hurricane Polo's remnants flood US Southwest, force evacuations
items.summary: The storm's remnants battered the US Southwest, flooding roadways and forcing residents of small New Mexico towns to evacuate over fears a dam could fail. It is the latest in a run of severe weather events across the country this month.

items.headline: Cuba accuses US of economic war at UN Assembly
items.summary: Cuban foreign minister Bruno Rodriguez Parrilla told the UN General Assembly that Washington is waging an economic war against the Cuban people, as the US Treasury separately tightened sanctions guidance on Cuba. The exchange adds to strained US-Latin America relations this year.

items.headline: UK police arrest five over terror plot near US airbase
items.summary: British police arrested five men on suspicion of terror offences near an air base used by US forces in the UK. The arrests come amid heightened security concerns across Europe over threats to military infrastructure.

items.headline: Taiwan passes drone funding as it indicts chip smugglers
items.summary: Taiwan's parliament ended a deadlock to secure funding for its drone programme amid rising cross-strait tension with Beijing, while prosecutors indicted nine people over an alleged chip-smuggling scheme. Both moves reflect Taipei's push to guard its tech and defence edge.

items.headline: Indonesia's Prabowo fires finance minister amid falling approval
items.summary: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto replaced his finance minister with a deputy as his approval ratings slide, opening the way for rivals to capitalise politically. The reshuffle signals pressure on Jakarta's economic policy team ahead of a tougher fiscal year.

items.headline: Philippines-China resupply understanding over shoal appears broken
items.summary: A "provisional understanding" between Beijing and Manila over Philippine resupply missions to the Second Thomas Shoal appears to have broken down, reviving friction in the South China Sea. The standoff keeps a key regional flashpoint unresolved.

items.headline: Myanmar seeks regional re-engagement as junta tightens grip
items.summary: Myanmar's military-backed government is pushing for renewed regional engagement even as it maintains what critics call a "parody democracy," with the whereabouts of Nobel laureate Aung San Suu Kyi still a closely guarded secret. The move tests ASEAN's stance on the junta.

items.headline: Russia expands military again as Ukraine war grinds on
items.summary: Russia's military announced its fourth expansion this year as its war in Ukraine appears to stall on the battlefield, even as Moscow and Kyiv traded accusations over strikes on energy infrastructure. The build-up signals no near-term end to the conflict.

items.headline: French firefighters, students protest budget cuts in Paris, Lille
items.summary: French firefighters demonstrated in Paris demanding more resources and funding, while students in Lille blocked schools and burned bicycles to protest government budget proposals. The unrest adds to pressure on Paris as it tries to rein in its deficit.

items.headline: Union Cabinet approves renaming Kerala to "Keralam"
items.summary: The Union Cabinet cleared a proposal to rename the State of Kerala as "Keralam," after which the President will refer the Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, 2026, to the state assembly for its views. The move follows a long-pending demand from Kerala's government.

items.headline: Cabinet clears Rs 7,927-crore railway multitracking projects
items.summary: The Union Cabinet approved railway multitracking projects worth roughly Rs 7,927 crore, aimed at easing congestion on key freight and passenger corridors. The investment fits the government's broader push to expand rail capacity ahead of the next fiscal year.

items.headline: Lok Sabha refers FCRA amendment bill to joint panel
items.summary: The Lok Sabha passed a motion referring the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026, to a 31-member joint parliamentary committee for scrutiny. The panel, with members from both houses, must report back by the first week of the Winter Session.

items.headline: Congress's Venugopal says Rahul Gandhi to lead INDIA bloc
items.summary: AICC general secretary K C Venugopal said Rahul Gandhi will be the face of the INDIA alliance and lead it into the 2029 Lok Sabha elections. The statement signals the opposition bloc is already positioning its leadership well ahead of the next general election.

items.headline: Supreme Court: confession alone can't justify preventive detention
items.summary: The Supreme Court held that authorities cannot pass a preventive detention order relying solely on an accused's confessional statement. The ruling tightens the evidentiary bar for detention orders and reinforces due-process safeguards against arbitrary state action.

items.headline: Supreme Court issues notice on patent term adjustment plea
items.summary: The Supreme Court issued notice on a plea seeking a Patent Term Adjustment mechanism in India, questioning whether patentees should get extra protection when delays in grant eat into the 20-year term. A favourable ruling could reshape patent-filing strategy for pharma and tech firms.

items.headline: Uttar Pradesh: SP names Rajya Sabha picks as EC readies roll
items.summary: The Samajwadi Party named Ram Gopal and Dhanraj Parimal Nathwani as its Rajya Sabha candidates as nominations were filed, while the Election Commission prepares to publish Uttar Pradesh's draft SIR electoral roll. Both developments feed into the state's shifting political calculus ahead of future polls.

items.headline: Agra court to rule on Saurabh murder "blue drum" case
items.summary: A verdict is expected in Agra in the high-profile Saurabh Rajput murder case, in which the victim's body was found stuffed in a blue drum. The case drew nationwide attention over allegations against the victim's wife and her family.

items.headline: Maharashtra: six killed in highway crash as rain floods Mumbai
items.summary: Six people were killed and one seriously injured when an SUV hit a divider on the Georai-Beed highway, while heavy rain flooded parts of Pune, Satara, Solapur, Raigad, Mumbai and the wider metropolitan region. The dual incidents strained state disaster-response resources.

items.headline: Government denies plan to scrap NEET-UG amid criticism
items.summary: The government clarified it has no proposal to discontinue the NEET-UG medical entrance exam or restore state-wise tests, pushing back against calls to scrap the single national exam. The clarification comes as scrutiny of exam-conduct issues continues.

items.headline: UGC chief: no decision yet on merging NEET, JEE, CUET
items.summary: UGC chairman M Jagadesh Kumar said no decision has been made on merging NEET, JEE and CUET, and that nothing would be imposed on students. The statement aims to calm anxiety among aspirants amid recurring speculation about a single unified entrance test.

items.headline: India's 10-year bond yield hits 7.11%, highest since May
items.summary: India's benchmark 10-year government bond yield rose six basis points to 7.11%, its highest level since May 21, as elevated oil prices and global yield pressure weighed on sentiment. Rising borrowing costs could squeeze corporate margins and the government's own fiscal math.

items.headline: Four IPOs open as Orient Cables, Runwal raise Rs 1,776 crore
items.summary: Orient Cables and Runwal Enterprises led four new IPOs seeking to raise a combined Rs 1,776 crore, with listing scheduled for early October. The steady primary-market pipeline shows continued investor appetite for new issues despite choppy secondary markets.

items.headline: Ultraviolette raises $85 million led by Yali Capital, TDK Ventures
items.summary: Indian deep-tech and EV startup Ultraviolette raised $85 million in a round led by Yali Capital and TDK Ventures. The deal signals continued investor appetite for India's electric-mobility and deep-tech startups even as overall funding rounds get more selective.

items.headline: India's 2026 startup funding hits $17.1 billion, up 12.5%
items.summary: Indian startups have raised $17.1 billion across 1,540 equity rounds so far in 2026, a 12.5% rise over the same period last year, even as investors concentrate capital in fewer, larger deals. The trend points to a maturing but more selective funding ecosystem.

items.headline: 60% of Indian employers plan to expand hiring: TeamLease
items.summary: A TeamLease survey found 60% of employers plan to expand headcount in the second half of FY27, with e-commerce and tech startups showing the strongest hiring outlook. Informal and contractual work still dominates, though, as weak manufacturing growth limits formal job creation.

items.headline: US 30-year Treasury yield hits highest since 2002
items.summary: US stocks finished modestly lower as the 30-year Treasury yield climbed to its highest level since 2002 and the 10-year held above 5%, even as oil prices fell. Rising long-term borrowing costs are pressuring equity valuations worldwide.

items.headline: Oil slips toward $89 a barrel as Saudi exports recover
items.summary: Crude fell to around $89 a barrel, down nearly 4%, on reports of indirect Iran-US talks, while Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline exports recovered to about half capacity. Middle East crude flows are now near 98% of pre-war levels, easing some supply-risk premium.

items.headline: Bitget resumes withdrawals after $350 million hack
items.summary: Crypto exchange Bitget resumed Bitcoin withdrawals that were suspended after suspected North Korean hackers breached its systems and stole more than $350 million. The incident adds to a string of major crypto-exchange breaches this year tied to state-linked hacking groups.

items.headline: ShinyHunters claims breach of FBI agent, applicant data
items.summary: Hacking group ShinyHunters claimed it breached FBI systems and stole data on agents and job applicants. If verified, the claim would mark a serious lapse for a top US law-enforcement agency and could fuel further extortion attempts against government targets.

items.headline: Hackers exploit Citrix NetScaler zero-day for network access
items.summary: Security researchers say attackers exploited a Citrix NetScaler zero-day, tracked as CVE-2026-88772, to deploy custom web shells and tunnelling malware, gaining root access and stealing credentials. Enterprises running unpatched NetScaler appliances face heightened risk of deep network compromise.

items.headline: New "NeedyMantis" malware hits telecom, university networks
items.summary: A newly identified malware family dubbed NeedyMantis has been found in targeted intrusions at telecom firms, universities, medical nonprofits, intergovernmental bodies and government contractors. The broad target list suggests a well-resourced campaign focused on espionage rather than financial theft.

items.headline: Study suggests bats first evolved in Europe 65 million years ago
items.summary: A genomic and fossil study suggests bats first evolved in Europe around 65 to 60 million years ago before spreading globally, reshaping earlier theories about the mammal group's origins. The findings could help explain how bats diversified into today's more than 1,400 species.

items.headline: ISRO, NASA mark one year of NISAR radar satellite in orbit
items.summary: ISRO and NASA celebrated one year of the joint NISAR Earth-observing radar satellite in orbit, which has begun delivering detailed images of the planet's surface. The mission is expected to aid disaster monitoring, agriculture and infrastructure planning as it moves into full science operations.

items.headline: ISRO lines up Gaganyaan, GSLV and LVM3 missions
items.summary: ISRO is preparing an uncrewed orbital test under the Gaganyaan human-spaceflight programme alongside upcoming GSLV missions and a commercial LVM3 launch. The packed schedule underlines India's push to expand both its human-spaceflight and commercial launch capabilities.

items.headline: WHO declares cruise-ship hantavirus outbreak over
items.summary: The World Health Organization declared over a hantavirus outbreak linked to the cruise ship MV Hondius after no new cases emerged. The episode highlighted the risk of rare zoonotic disease clusters spreading through enclosed travel settings such as cruise ships.

items.headline: India win Asian Games women's cricket gold over Sri Lanka
items.summary: India beat Sri Lanka in the final to win Asian Games 2026 women's cricket gold, posting an Asian Games record score of 216/3 after earlier beating Bangladesh by 114 runs in the semifinal. Pakistan took bronze after beating Bangladesh in the third-place playoff.

items.headline: India, Pakistan reach Asian Games men's cricket semifinals
items.summary: India and Pakistan advanced to the Asian Games 2026 men's cricket semifinals as higher seeds after their quarterfinals against Afghanistan and Hong Kong China were washed out by rain. Pakistan face Bangladesh and India face Sri Lanka in the semifinals on Thursday.

items.headline: Kunlavut wins Asian Games badminton gold, reclaims No. 1
items.summary: Thailand's Kunlavut Vitidsarn beat Singapore's Loh Kean Yew 21-12, 21-16 to win the Asian Games men's singles badminton title, returning to the world No. 1 ranking. It was his first singles title since January's Malaysia Open.

items.headline: Sindhu reaches Asian Games quarterfinals as India take bronze
items.summary: PV Sindhu reached the women's singles quarterfinals at the Asian Games before losing to Tokyo 2020 champion Chen Yufei of China, as India's badminton campaign ended with a solitary bronze in the men's team event. It was a modest return for a squad chasing multiple medals.

items.headline: Liverpool rout Marseille, Bayern beat Union SG in Champions League
items.summary: Liverpool thrashed Olympique Marseille 3-0 and Bayern Munich beat Union SG 2-0 in the Champions League, while Atalanta lost 3-2 at home to Athletic Club. The results tighten the early group standings as the competition's matchday schedule progresses.

items.headline: Djokovic returns to China Open for first time since 2015
items.summary: Novak Djokovic is set to play the China Open for the first time since 2015, with a possible early meeting against Alexander Zverev, while Carlos Alcaraz opens his Japan Open campaign against an American opponent. The Asian swing marks a key late-season stretch for the ATP Tour's top players.

items.headline: Uzbekistan win Chess Olympiad as Turlov elected FIDE president
items.summary: Uzbekistan won the 46th Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, with GM Mukhiddin Madaminov delivering the decisive win over Ukraine in the final round. Separately, Timur Turlov was elected FIDE president in a runoff, beating Wadim Rosenstein by 110 votes to 85.
